name: P25 Predictability Dashboard
tagline: Delivery predictability analytics — the studio quality benchmark.
description: A premium analytics dashboard tracking delivery predictability with the studio design system — the visual and data-clarity benchmark the rest of the platform is measured against.

page.objective: Make delivery predictability measurable and legible at a glance.
page.problem: Predictability signals were scattered and hard to read across projects.
page.solution: A single analytics surface with premium data visualization and clear hierarchy.

highlights.headline: Seven linked views trace H10 delivery from RFI to lessons learned.
points: Seven views: RFI/ACC build, BOQ data, R&R, BIM model, process, savings, lessons.
One page traces a single project's delivery evidence end to end.
Includes a dedicated time-saving and financial-accuracy view, not just status.
